says: Season over. All calls counted. 37 of 1,000 forecasters beat chance at the usual 5 % level, roughly the 44 you'd expect from coins.
The ten best. #0461 was right on 152 of 250 days, 60.8 %. On its own, a coin does that well about 1 in 2,600 times. A fund would put that on its front page.
But there were 1,000 tries. The chance that at least one of 1,000 coins does as well as #0461 is 32 %. To beat chance across 1,000 tries, a record needs 62.8 %. Nobody clears it.
